audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Urgot all seven stages, including two items, while whys[6] directly beneath says your R and stun chains win 5v5s at that point regardless of his damage.
audit.why: A chart that concedes the stage its own why claims you win is self-contradicting. The packet stage read gives Sejuani the two-item stage and Urgot everything before it, which matches both the prose and a losing 41.94% lane.
audit.corrected: Two-item stage set to Sejuani in both layers; stages 1 through first item left with Urgot.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain and Fear Beyond Death are named constantly with no cooldowns or ranges, and whys[2] asserts Disdain 'almost always' being available without saying how often that is.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 seconds — barely rank-scaled, so 16 at rank 1 is the number the whole lane is played around. Fear Beyond Death is 100 seconds at rank 1 and reaches 2500. Purge only reaches 490, which is the line the player actually has to stand outside of.
audit.corrected: Disdain's 16 seconds written into whys[1], whys[2] and wants.you[1]; Purge's 490 range into whys[0] and wants.foe[0]; the R's 2500 range and 100 seconds into spikes[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain shields him on the charge, and this appears nowhere in either layer.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit: he 'charges in a direction, shielding himself'. So his flip is also his defensive cooldown — committing your full chain into a fresh Disdain spends your burst into a shield, and forcing it out first is the whole sequencing problem in this matchup.
audit.corrected: The shield written into whys[1] and whys[2] as the reason to make him spend Disdain before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor's slow immunity is never mentioned against a champion whose opener is a slow.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge slows and Purge slows, but Fury of the North grants immunity to slows while Frost Armor holds — so his Q into W setup does not actually stick an out-of-combat Sejuani, and the danger only begins once he has chipped you into combat.
audit.corrected: Written into early as the reason the first step-up is survivable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields build the entire game plan on Purge dealing percent-max-HP damage, and two state Fear Beyond Death executes below 25%.
audit.why: Riot's text for Purge says only that he 'slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies' and triggers Echoing Flames — no percent-health component, and Urgot's kit file carries no percentHealth flag on any ability. Fear Beyond Death says 'below a health threshold' with no number. I cannot verify either, and both drive real decisions — whys[3] and spikes[2] tell the player their tank items feed his damage, which if wrong is a build-changing error.
audit.corrected: Left every one of those fields untouched and recorded them in unverified. Nothing I wrote repeats either claim.

edits.after: His Disdain (E) is 16 seconds at rank 1, intercepts your Q mid-dash, hurls you behind him and shields him on the way in — so your only engage feeds his defensive cooldown as well as his position.
edits.before: His Disdain (E) intercepts your Q mid-dash and repositions you behind him, turning your only engage into a liability — level 2 changes nothing about this danger and his W still wins any trade he starts.

edits.after: Full kit online, but so is his: Corrosive Charge into Purge into a Disdain flip dismantles your Q-W-E, and at 16 seconds his flip is back for nearly every wave, shield included.
edits.before: Full kit online but so is his full rotation: Corrosive Charge slow into W into Disdain flip dismantles the Q-W-E combo entirely if Disdain is available, which it almost always is at this stage.

edits.after: Fear Beyond Death gives Urgot a kill-confirm execute at 2500 range on a 100-second rank-1 cooldown — take a trade you had no business taking and the R closes it from across the lane.
edits.before: Fear Beyond Death gives Urgot a kill-confirm execute — if your HP drops below the threshold during a trade you had no business taking, the R finishes it and there is nothing you can do.

edits.after: Track Disdain's 16 seconds at rank 1 and only step up to Q once it is visibly spent
edits.before: Track his Disdain cooldown and only step up to Q when it is visibly on cooldown

edits.after: Hold you inside Purge's 490 range every trade so Echoing Flames chips you before you can stun him
edits.before: Activate Purge (W shotgun legs) in melee range every trade to shred percent-max-HP before you can stun him

edits.after: His W fires the instant you step inside its 490 range — at level 1 you have no Frost stacks and no engage, though Frost Armor does make you immune to the Corrosive Charge slow he opens with, so the first step-up is survivable until he chips you into combat. Take W at level 1, hit the wave, and give up CS rather than stand in Purge range. At level 2 your Q comes online but do not engage with it: Disdain intercepts mid-dash, hurls you behind him and shields him doing it, wasting your gap-closer and leaving you in his W range. Level 3 gives you the full chain, but only threaten it once Disdain is visibly down — 16 seconds at rank 1 is the window you are waiting for.
edits.before: His W shotgun legs fire the instant you step into melee range — at level 1 you have no Frost stacks, no engage, and his percent-max-HP damage ignores the resistance bonus your passive Fury of the North gives. Take W at level 1, hit the wave, and give up the first CS if it means staying outside his W trigger range. At level 2 your Q comes online but do not use it to engage: Disdain (E) intercepts mid-dash and puts you behind him, wasting your only gap-closer and leaving you in his W range with no escape. Level 3 gives you the full Q-W-E chain, but only threaten it if his Disdain is visibly on cooldown — without that window, the stun trade still ends badly because his percent-HP damage out-damages what your stun setup generates.

notes: THE THING THE USER NEEDS TO DECIDE: six fields on this page (whys[0], whys[3], whys[5], spikes[0], spikes[2], wants.foe[0], plus early and mid) assert that Purge deals percent-max-HP damage, and whys[3] and spikes[2] turn that into build advice — 'every tank item you buy increases the damage he deals per second'. Riot's Purge text says only that he slows himself and unloads on nearby enemies while triggering Echoing Flames, and Urgot's kit file carries no percentHealth flag on any ability. I could not verify it locally, so I left every one of those fields exactly as written and repeated the claim nowhere in my own text. If it is wrong, this page is telling Sejuani players not to build tank items. Also unverified and left alone: two fields put Fear Beyond Death's execute threshold at 25%, where Riot says only 'a health threshold'. What I did fix: Disdain shields him on the charge, which appeared nowhere, and it is 16 seconds at rank 1 — so his flip is also his defensive cooldown and the sequencing rule is to force it out before committing. Added Purge's 490 range, the R's 2500 range and 100 seconds, and Frost Armor's slow immunity against his Corrosive Charge opener.
